Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead.

The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict.

An accident connects four groups of people on three different continents: two young Moroccan goatherds, a vacationing American couple (Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett), a deaf Japanese teen and her father, and a Mexican nanny who takes her young charges across a border without parental permission.

The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect.
An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion.

A documentary following the decades-long crusade of investigative journalist Andrew Jennings to expose corruption inside FIFA, football's sole governing body and the largest sports organization in the world.
A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions.

In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim.

David (Woody Harrelson) and Diana Murphy (Demi Moore) are a loving couple with a bright future. David is a talented architect; Diana is a top-notch real estate agent. But when the recession hits, their finances take a nosedive. In a last-ditch effort to save their dream home, they head to Las Vegas to win their mortgage money gambling. After they lose everything, a mysterious billionaire (Robert Redford) offers the solution to their money problems: $1 million -- if he can sleep with Diana.

Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help.

When a research ship is sent to explore an island thought to be rich in oil, paleontologist Jack Prescott sneaks aboard, having heard strange rumors about the island. En route, the crew rescues Dwan, the sole survivor of a shipwreck. When they arrive, they find native people living in fear of a monster called Kong. The natives kidnap Dwan and sacrifice her to what turns out to be an enormous ape. Dwan is eventually rescued, and the ape captured for a gala exhibit.
Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next.

A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened.
Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.
Awe-inspiring and jaw-dropping meteorological marvels.

Getting caught in extreme weather can lead to dire and dangerous circumstances, but for those who find themselves trapped by ferocious conditions, the spirit to survive, or a heroic helping hand, is often the difference between life and death.
With the right meteorological mix, extreme weather can strike anywhere at any time; its wrath appears to be random, but sometimes it comes back to the same spot again and again.

Christian faces a crucial skills test on a 38-ton excavator and digs down to the blue clay layer that Ray hopes will be the key to the team finding a fortune; Elley and Christian do some prospecting and find the biggest piece of gold so far.

p.d: Un programa basado en el original Extreme Makeover de EE. UU., en donde un equipo de diseñadores reconstruyen y embellecen la casa de gente necesitada en un tiempo muy corto.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.
An ex-🥊 [UFC] UFC fighter ends up working at a rowdy bar in the Florida Keys.

Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.
The discovery of a bullet-riddled body leads to an investigation into the 1970s world of disco, cocaine and sex.
A monk (Clyde Kusatsu) teaches Billie how to use her power of projection to find her sister; Phoebe celebrates her independence by throwing a housewarming party that gets out of control.

When Henry gets too involved in her magical world, Paige begins to realize the difficulties of dating a mortal; Billie finds her missing sister, Christy (Marnette Patterson), whom demons have held captive for years.
Piper organizes an engagement party for Paige and Henry, but the couple begin to get cold feet.
Phoebe goes on a journey through her past loves to try to revive her excitement for romance; a group of magical teens comes to the manor seeking refuge from demons.
Coop realizes that he has fallen for Phoebe, but she yearns to be with a mortal; Piper tracks down killer demons.
An excavation project unearths the remains of a man and a woman who had been active in the counterculture scene before disappearing in 1969.
Rush and Valens reopen the 1987 case of a high-school basketball star who was stabbed to death hours after leading his team to the state championship.
A drunken driver's hit-and-run confession leads the detectives to discover that foul play -- not an accident -- may have killed the victim.
The current investigation of a murdered man links to a cold case involving a young woman killed after leaving a political event on Election night.
Rush and Valens reopen the 1985 case of a wealthy stockbroker killed during an apparent carjacking gone awry.

Robert McCall (Denzel Washington), a man of mysterious origin who believes he has put the past behind him, dedicates himself to creating a quiet new life. However, when he meets Teri (Chloë Grace Moretz), a teenager who has been manhandled by violent Russian mobsters, he simply cannot walk away. With his set of formidable skills, McCall comes out of self-imposed retirement and emerges as an avenging angel, ready to take down anyone who brutalizes the helpless.
Una pareja, cuyos hijos han abandonado el nido, deberá hacerse la pregunta: ¿los hijos pueden ser ambiciosos?

Rusty Griswold, recordando con cariño los viajes de su infancia a Walley World, sorprende a su mujer y a sus dos hijos con una excursión al parque de atracciones favorito de Estados Unidos. Siguiendo los pasos de su padre, Rusty y su pandilla toman el auto y se lanzan a la carretera para disfrutar de la tan necesaria unión familiar. Pronto, la promesa de diversión se convierte en una desventura tras otra para la nueva generación de Griswolds y para cualquiera que se cruce con ellos.
Un banquero inversionista que será encarcelado le pide al hombre que lava su carro que lo prepare para su vida detrás de las rejas.

Un reclutador de la Marina es asesinado y el equipo CSI investiga en el mundo de la milicia para intentar hallar al homicida; Natalia debe enfrentar a su exmarido cuando él invita a salir a una compañera de trabajo.
La niñera de una familia rica aparece muerta durante una fiesta.
Horatio busca en el pasado de Delko cuando un francotirador se enfoca en el motel donde Delko se hospeda.
La investigación de un trabajador de censo muerto envía al equipo en una persecución a alta velocidad y una explosión que amenaza las vidas de los CSI.

Un oportuno encuentro con un sujeto de apariencia sospechosa lleva a Jane y a Lisbon a descubrir una red de tráfico de seres humanos. Además, Lisbon se siente tentada por la oferta de Pike, quien quiere que se mude a Washington DC con él.

El gran jurado debe decidir si Jane irá a juicio por la muerte de Red John. Por otro lado, Lisbon intenta averiguar cómo afectaría su salida a Patrick. Abbott y Cho siguen nuevas pistas del tráfico ilegal de personas.

Rusty Griswold, recordando con cariño los viajes de su infancia a Walley World, sorprende a su mujer y a sus dos hijos con una excursión al parque de atracciones favorito de Estados Unidos. Siguiendo los pasos de su padre, Rusty y su pandilla toman el auto y se lanzan a la carretera para disfrutar de la tan necesaria unión familiar. Pronto, la promesa de diversión se convierte en una desventura tras otra para la nueva generación de Griswolds y para cualquiera que se cruce con ellos.

Remembering fond, childhood memories of his trip to Walley World, Rusty Griswold surprises his wife and two sons with a cross-country excursion to America's favorite fun park. Following in his father's footsteps, Rusty and the gang pack up the car and hit the road for some much-needed family bonding. Soon, the promise of fun turns into one misadventure after another for the next generation of Griswolds and anyone who encounters them.

When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other.

Dapper Koala Buster Moon presides over a once-grand theater that has fallen on hard times. An eternal optimist, and a bit of a scoundrel, he loves his theater above all and will do anything to preserve it. Facing the crumbling of his life's ambition, he takes one final chance to restore his fading jewel to its former glory by producing the world's greatest singing competition. Five contestants emerge: a mouse, a timid elephant, a pig, a gorilla and a punk-rock porcupine.

With the imminent destruction of Krypton, their home planet, Jor-El (Russell Crowe) and his wife seek to preserve their race by sending their infant son to Earth. The child's spacecraft lands at the farm of Jonathan (Kevin Costner) and Martha (Diane Lane) Kent, who name him Clark and raise him as their own son. Though his extraordinary abilities have led to the adult Clark (Henry Cavill) living on the fringe of society, he finds he must become a hero to save those he loves from a dire threat.

In the 1940s South Carolina, mill worker Noah Calhoun (Ryan Gosling) and rich girl Allie (Rachel McAdams) are desperately in love. But her parents don't approve. When Noah goes off to serve in World War II, it seems to mark the end of their love affair. In the interim, Allie becomes involved with another man (James Marsden). But when Noah returns to their small town years later, on the cusp of Allie's marriage, it soon becomes clear that their romance is anything but over.

Steve Backshall looks at animals that are both deadly and endangered. Threatened with habitat loss, Steve explores why mighty animals like the chimpanzee, the mountain gorilla and the harpy eagle are so few, while in Madagascar he meets the most bizarre animal he's ever seen, the Aye Aye.
Steve is in South Africa, home to a huge number of animals on the Deadly 60. However, big predators aren't what Steve is here for, as he's exploring the plight of the rhino.

Jeremy Clarkson and James May investigate an increasingly popular type of tall hatchback often referred to as a 'crossover'. Meanwhile, Richard Hammond is in Italy driving a pair of Lamborghinis, the sensational Aventador Roadster and a 570 horsepower riot of carbon fibre and space age styling called the Sesto Elemento. Plus, James May is at the test track to drive a modern recreation of the classic Porsche 911.
A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

Eric Knowles quizzes fairgoers at Brighton Racecourse about a mystery item, and two more teams gallop around the stalls in search of deals. Married couple David and Helen are in red, with antiques expert Serhat Ahmet by their side. David reckons that he is good at haggling, but Helen is not so sure! Their opponents in blue are Lenchina and her husband Terence, who are shopping for bargains with expert Catherine Southon.

With three items saved from Witley Recycling Centre in Surrey, upcycling expert Sarah Moore gets to work trying to turn rubbish into cash. Bruce is on the case to rescue candy-coloured kitchen units, but will his makeover dazzle or disappoint? Sarah attempts sign-writing on mirrors, but will her efforts produce profits?
Three challenges stand between the remaining sewers and the final: leather jackets, men's shirts and a little black dress.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
The game show that mixes general knowledge quizzing and bowling.
Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

Starting in Hassocks, Michael makes his way to the beautiful Sussex village of Ditchling, where, between the wars, a Roman Catholic community of artists made their home. Michael finds out how they made their mark on the village, the capital and the nation's railways. In the seaside town of Bexhill-on-Sea, Michael hears of the work of the wartime air raid precautions wardens, immortalised in the BBC series 'Dad's Army'.

Eva Longoria visits the northeastern state of Nuevo León, bordering her home state of Texas. As little grows there, and with meat on every menu, inventive and resourceful chefs transform simple ingredients into culinary delights.

Beneath billowing clouds, in China's far south-west, rich jungles nestle below towering peaks. Jewel-coloured birds and ancient tribes share forested valleys where wild elephants still roam. These remote forests stretch into northern territories where normally deserts would be found. How do these forests exist? Perhaps the rugged landscape holds the key.

The experts visit The Ulster Folk and Transport Museum, Croombe in South Worcestershire, Crowcombe Court in Somerset and Bletchley Park to lay their hands on some unusual items to take to auction. Plus, Paul Martin investigates the historic landscape of Mount Edgcumbe in Cornwall.

Larry Dean, Kirsty Gallagher, Sam Quek and Lemn Sissay take on a series of quiz rounds selected by Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

Clive travels 200 miles east of Havana to the historic town of Trinidad, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Along the way, Clive meets the octogenarian carpenter whose skills have contributed to keeping this 16th-century city standing.

p.d: Gumball and Darwin seek healthy food for their family, but an evil food consortium controls the industry. Gumball vows to wear a shell and partake in strange Fitzgerald traditions, in order to help Penny get through a tense family birthday party.

Shaun's flock lives a peaceful life under the watchful eye of their sheepdog Bitzer. A bored Shaun dresses up as the farmer to entertain the flock. Realising he now has the power to boss Bitzer around, Shaun takes the opportunity to throw a party for the flock, and all goes to plan until Bitzer puts two and two together. Then, Shaun encounters the real farmer.
Danger Mouse hunts for Baron von Greenback. He is nowhere to be found, but then what is this? The baron pops up on Penfold's favourite TV game show "Who Wants to Marry a Queen".
The tired heroes must quest to find out and stop whatever is making the loud wailing noise that has kept the residents of the Forest up all night.

When the exclusive Club 37 opens up in HQ, Orli and Ozzie set out to crack 37 cases so they can enter it. But with more fun clubs opening, will the agents' club obsession get the better of them?
Steve Backshall reveals the super sucker of all sharks, the nurse shark. This shark has a taste for shellfish and armoured crustaceans. In Mexico, Steve finds one resting amongst the coral.

Nigel Havers hosts as five dealers bid to buy items brought in by the public, including a vintage hairdressing collection, a WWII flying helmet and a unique chair.

Stars of stage and screen, Simon Williams and Duncan Preston team up with antiques experts James Lewis and Philip Serrell for a celebrity buying trip around Essex. Armed with £400 each and two stunning classic cars, their mission - to acquire items to sell for profit at auction in Torquay, Devon. On the way Duncan tries his hand at an ancient craft and a collector of sporting memorabilia has a tale to tell about London Mayor Boris Johnson.
Lily Savage hosts as contestants, with the help of a panel of celebrity guests, attempt to fill in the missing words of statements and phrases in order to beat the competition and win a prize.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.

Ross Kemp presents the quiz as friends Craig, Kerry, Tony and Louise take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.
Andrew from London, Amy from Edinburgh, Jean from Lincolnshire and Success from Romford come together in the hope that as a team they can beat the Chaser. Hosted by Bradley Walsh.

It's a time travelling episode of `Celebrity Antiques Road Trip' as the sixth Doctor Who, Colin Baker pairs up with Blue Peter stalwart, Peter Purves who played the first Doctor's assistant. The two will be exploring Herefordshire and Worcestershire in the TARDIS cunningly disguised as a 1970 Morris Minor, joined by experts Will Axon and James Braxton. They're armed with £400 to buy antiques that will make profit at auction, and on the way, Colin once again comes face-to-face with The Daleks.
Nicola Stapleton and Johnny Vegas face off against each other as they compete to win a big cash prize for their chosen charity, with a little help from their families.

Cleveland ruiniert Rallos Weihnachten, als er ihm versehentlich erzählt, dass sein Vater nicht der ist, für den er ihn hält. Daraufhin macht Cleveland sich auf die Suche nach Rallos verschwundenem Vater, um Weihnachten für ihn zu retten.

Die Jungs haben eine Oculus-Rift-Virtual-Reality-Brille bezogen. Jetzt wissen sie nur gar nicht mehr, wer von ihnen in der realen Welt ist und wer in der virtuellen Realität gefangen ist. Butter ist überzeugt, in der Virtuellen zu sein.

Kanada hat eine App für Handys entwickelt, die die Sucht der Schwachen ausnutzt, um Geld für den Aufbau des Landes zu machen. Stan ist abhängig von dem neuen Handyspiel von Terrance und Phillip. Als Randy das herausfindet, mischt er sich ein.

Butters will nicht mit Wendys Freundin ausgehen, da Kim Kardashian seine Freundin sei. Wendy nennt Kim daraufhin einen "Hobbit", der seine Bilder im Internet verschönt. Sie bekommt viel Ärger in der Schule, während alle ihre Freundinnen "verbessern".

An Lindas Geburtstag steht Bob ohne Geschenk da - er muss sich also schnellstens eine Überraschung für sie einfallen lassen. Er schickt sie aus dem Haus, um etwas vorzubereiten. Doch plötzlich verschwindet Linda. Die Suche erfordert Teamwork.

Die Belchers können ein Strandhaus in Craggy Neck aufgrund eines Sturms nicht verlassen. Doch dann treffen sie den mysteriösen Besitzer des Anwesens an und es stellt sich heraus, dass der Sturm das geringere Übel darstellt.

Stan wird misstrauisch, als er bemerkt, dass sein gesprächiger Nachbar Tuttle seinen Rasen nicht sprengt. Fortan schleicht er durch die Nachbarschaft, um dem Nachbar etwas nachweisen zu können. Die Erkenntnisse sind für Stan mehr als schockierend, bemerkt er doch, dass in der direkten Nachbarschaft US-Amerikaner mit arabischer Herkunft leben.

Stan will endlich seinen "gestriegelten Bastard"-Nachbarn Chuck White bei der allsonntäglichen Fahrt zur Kirche besiegen und schneller ankommen. Doch es gelingt nicht. Und noch schlimmer: Der Diakon erklärt in seiner Messe, dass die White-Tochter Betsy für die USA als Turnerin zu den Olympischen Spielen fahren wird.

Eine unerwartete Gelegenheit bietet sich der stets leidenschaftlichen Janine an der Abbott Elementary School, wo das neue Semester naht. Ava zeigt eine andere Seite der Schulleiterin und Melissa wird eine unerwartete Frage gestellt.

Chris hat noch kein Date für den Homecoming-Ball - bis ihm Mrs. Morello die neue Schülerin Jenise vorstellt und ihn ersucht, mit ihr auf den Ball zu gehen. Dadurch gerät Chris allerdings in eine Zwickmühle: Zwar findet er durchaus Gefallen an Jenise und würde deshalb Mrs. Morellos Bitte gerne nachkommen, gleichzeitig jedoch erwartet Greg von ihm, während des Balles bei ihm zu bleiben, da dieser keine Begleiterin gefunden hat.

Aufgeschreckt durch eine Fernsehwerbung wollen die Frauen des Hauses dieses babysicher machen. Mike ist davon wenig begeistert, muss aber klein beigeben. Als seine Ehefrau Vanessa den kleinen Boyd hütet, spürt sie die Nachteile der Sicherheitsmaßnahmen buchstäblich am eigenen Leib.

Mike macht zu schaffen, dass seine Töchter keinen Gefallen mehr daran finden, Halloween zu feiern. Wenigstens dem kleinen Boyd beschert Mike trotz ausdrücklichen Verbots einen gruseligen Ausflug. Ein kleines Versehen führt dazu, dass dieser auffliegt: Mike bringt das falsche kostümierte Kind nach Hause.

Lois und Hal wollen ein letztes ruhiges Wochenende vor der Geburt ihres Babys erleben. Sie vertrauen die Jungs ihren Freunden und Verwandten an, doch Reese hat andere Pläne: Er schleicht sich wieder nach Hause, um dort eine richtige Party zu feiern.

Malcolm lernt den ewigen Verlierer Leonard kennen, der besessen ist vom Schach. Sie spielen mehrere Runden, doch jede endet mit einem Patt. Malcolm nimmt Leonard mit in Craigs Supermarkt, um ihn dort als Ladenhilfe vorzustellen.

Sam steht unter Druck: Ihr Verleger verlangt Beweise für ihre Isaac-Biografie. Mit Jay an ihrer Seite begibt sie sich auf eine spannende Schnitzeljagd nach Isaacs verstecktem Tagebuch. Die Suche führt das Duo durch verschlungene Pfade.

A judge lashes out at a defence attorney who refers to his drink-driving client as a hero; a religious leader convicted of sexual abuse hears from his victims.
Kayleigh Hanks was violently strangled by her boyfriend Ian Paton at her flat in Bexhill-on-Sea, whilst their baby daughter slept in the same room.
At just 15 years of age, James Fairweather took the lives of two innocent people, citing psychosis as the reason for his bloodthirsty urges.
The story of double-murderer Janbaz Tarin, who killed his ex-partner and her mother after they discovered he had a secret wife and children.

When the body of a man is found hanging from a tree with his arms bound and FED scrawled on his chest, Kentucky State Police and the FBI must unravel a complicated mystery. Was this a vicious act of targeted retribution, or something else entirely?

35-year-old tattoo artist Adam Young has disappeared. The only clue to his whereabouts is surveillance footage. The footage shows Adam and two friends leaving his apartment in downtown Calgary.

A 'body carrier' is intercepted with a haul of narcotics strapped to his back. Elsewhere, an international courier faces serious trouble when a concealed firearm is discovered inside his cargo.

Rick enjoys a weekend in Berlin, where history and the avant-garde dwell enticingly side by side. A city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an overwhelming array of innovative chefs offering delicious seasonal creations.

Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire. It is home to comfort dishes like tafelspitz and goulash, and it also gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the Wiener schnitzel.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy are in Wales, taking a glamorous road trip in the newest grand tourers from Bentley, Aston Martin and McLaren, before taking on their German rivals and 🏎️ [F1] Formula One legend Heinz-Harald Frentzen. Plus a tribute to the late, great Sir Stirling Moss.

Paddy introduces Chris and Freddie to his latest creation: an electric, all-terrain ice cream van for the 21st century. They also test the battery-powered Honda E, Vauxhall Corsa-e and Mini Electric in a race around a deserted Alton Towers.

Eine Frau hat ihren Ex-Freund verklagt, da dieser seine Schulden bei ihr nicht begleichen will.

Mat möchte mit Andreas und dessen Sohn Tobi in Australien Opale ausgraben. Nach einer erfolgreichen ersten Spurensuche hat Mat im Outback Schürfrechte erworben. Doch sie können sich bei ihrer Suche nicht auf bewährte Technik verlassen.

Mat hat sich eine Verletzung am Handgelenk zugezogen, also muss Andreas alleine nach Opalen suchen. Danach lassen sich die beiden Männer auf einen Deal ein, um den genauen Fundort eines kostbaren Edelmetalls zu erfahren.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Eine 15 Meter hohe Welle bricht mit unglaublicher Wucht über die Saga herein. Um ein Haar wäre die Besatzung des Fangschiffs über Bord gespült worden, denn Skipper Eliott Neese hatte seine Crew nicht rechtzeitig gewarnt. Die Seeleute fürchten 680 Kilometer nordwestlich von Dutch Harbor um ihre Gesundheit. Der Kapitän mutet ihnen bei heftigem Seegang einiges zu. Unter den Krabbenfischern macht sich Unmut breit.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Die Saga kämpft sich mit einem Motorschaden in Richtung Heimathafen. Das voll beladene Fangschiff hat mächtig Schlagseite, denn es schleppt rund 25 Tonnen gefrorene Gischt mit sich herum. Dieser unnötige Ballast muss schnellstens von Bord, damit das Boot nicht kentert. Deshalb teilt Kapitän Elliott Neese seine Crew zu einer Sonderschicht ein. Statt sich auszuruhen, müssen die Männer Eis klopfen.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Am Flughafen Sabiha Gökçen ist eine Maschine aus Deutschland gelandet. Der Zoll richtet sein Augenmerk auf zwei Personen, die elektronische Geräte im Gepäck haben. Die beiden Männer geben an, für Dreharbeiten ins Land gereist zu sein.

Der Spürhund Benny hat mit seiner sensiblen Nase etwas erschnüffelt. Daraufhin müssen ein Mann und Frau am Göteborger Flughafen ihre Taschen ausleeren. Trägt das Pärchen Drogen am Körper? In Stockholm wirkt eine Reisende sehr nervös.

In Karlsruhe möchte ein Kunde einen Ehering beleihen. Der Mann will mit dem Darlehen einen Herd kaufen und den Ring bald wieder auslösen. Nikolaus Bode sieht sich derweil mit heiß geliebten Schätzen aus der Kindheit seines Kunden konfrontiert.
Im Pfandleihgeschäft gehören Überraschungen zum Alltag - so auch in Siegburg. Dort sorgt ein Kunde schon beim Betreten des Ladens für Alarmstimmung. Der Mann möchte Handgranaten verkaufen.

Ralf droht in München ein nervenaufreibendes Tauziehen mit ungewissem Ausgang. In Köln bekommt Jörg bei der Arbeit Unterstützung von seinem Sohn Benedikt, und in Kempen wird ein Routineauftrag zur kniffligen Herausforderung.

A look back at a selection of the wide variety of sports covered by ITV during the 1970s - from horse racing to table football, 🏎️ [F1] Formula 1 to darts - and including many iconic and memorable moments.

While in Kansas, the guys comb through a promising farmyard littered with stuff but are frustrated when they find nothing at all to buy. Their luck changes when they meet demolition expert Johnny Walker. His collection is staggering. However, will he agree to part with a rare grave marker and giant 300-pound boot? The next day, Johnny refers the guys to his collector neighbours.

Mike and Frank are in Missouri, heading towards an inherited old farm with plenty of promise, but then Danielle calls with news about an ultimate prize. She's tracked down a prolific collector with a rare 1937 Harley Knucklehead. Close to their target, and revved up about the classic bike, the guys agree to speed pick the old farm before moving on.
Arthur is asked to speak to the local Rotary Club, while Terry acts as a hotel house detective.
Nemesis sends its superagents to investigate why a country is breaking an international treaty by testing nuclear weapons under Antarctica.
Regan is determined to nail a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde who have already made fools of the police after one of them escaped from an ambulance following an audacious wages' theft.
Cowley winds up being accused of treachery when he tries to flush out a Soviet double agent working in MI5.
An investigation into the murders of three students leads to the discovery of a group of elderly Nazi soldiers being kept in an abandoned mine in Austria.

While picking in Missouri, the guys stop in at Sam and Stan's steelyard where the father-son duo takes them on a high-speed golf cart tour of their massive hangar and outbuildings, loaded with heaps of metal and rusty junk, but can Mike and Frank uncover anything worth buying? The team also goes freestyling and comes across an old farm where the owners are about to have an auction and badly need Frank and Mike's help.

Thanks to his vast collection of stuffed animals and weird curios, lifelong picker and yard sale aficionado Lester is known by his neighbours as the 'spooky collector'. Tension builds between Mike and Frank over the value of the animals, but both are thrilled to comb through his jam-packed outbuildings. Later on, the guys visit a hard-core Illinois collector who says he wants to downsize.

Regan discovers that successful people will stop at nothing to keep their skeletons in the cupboard when a wealthy, self-made tycoon is blackmailed for his part in a massacre during the Malayan Emergency.
CI5 and Hong Kong police join forces to bust a protection ring shielding terrorists, who are supplying drugs to US soldiers.
Angler Jeremy Wade heads to the Australian outback to try and catch the rare and fearsome freshwater sawfish, a shadowy predator said to be 18 feet long and known to attack boats.

Action from Round 12 of the season - the Rally of Chile. The roads are smooth and well-built but demand total precision. Visibility is often limited by fog and tree cover, and pace notes need to be dialled in perfectly - one missed call can send a car off into the undergrowth in a heartbeat.

Kaye and her daughter Lily are counting on their cleanliness to gain top marks at My Way Guest House in Broompark in County Durham. However, some of their guests make dusty discoveries.
David and Sophie host at The Old Orleton Inn in Wellington, Shropshire, where there are bathroom blues and cleanliness concerns. They try to win over their guests with their award-winning B&B.

Richard and Harriet pride themselves on their high-end rooms at The Royal George in Tintern, Monmouthshire. Their guests lap up the luxury, but some less-than-perfect scores shock the hosts.
It's the final day and the B&Bers meet for one last time to settle some scores. After bathroom blues and cleanliness concerns are aired, the payments are revealed and the winner announced.

It's the first day of the competition in Southampton and 25-year-old receptionist Anna Gibbons is planning a burlesque-themed dinner party to kick off the week. For her fellow diners though, a burlesque night hardly has mouths watering, and there are grumbles from the group that Anna's menu is a touch too simple.

Day two of the competition in Southampton sees party animal kitchen designer Darren Miller host a 90s raver-themed evening. When he awakes feeling unwell it's a doubt whether Darren will even manage to make it through the day.

It's the halfway point of the competition in Southampton and 43-year-old customer service adviser and food snob Greg Bell is planning a night fit for royalty and a chance to educate his guests in the art of fine dining.

Dock coordinator Tasha Whyte hosts the penultimate day in this competition from Southampton. Tasha is hoping her simple menu with fun entertainment will ease any tensions that remain between Greg and his fellow diners.

It's the final night of the competition in Southampton, and 43-year-old tax officer and staunch vegetarian Bijal is on a mission to create the ultimate dinner party with no meat. She's got her work cut out, according to committed-carnivore Darren, who points out that a meal isn't complete without 'a dead animal'.

Harri and Claire Chiba own the Vale of Berkeley Guesthouse in Gloucestershire. On arrival, Craig and Alec Coleman are left cold by the minimalist, magnolia decor, while artistic duo Charlie and Justin aren't thrilled with the no-frills toilet.

Day two of the competition is at Artist Residence in Penzance, Cornwall. The guests generally like the quirky nature of the art-filled rooms, but Blackpool veterans Craig and Alec Coleman think their room is too modern and find a hole in the ceiling.
Third to host are couple Alec and Craig Coleman of the award-winning Edenfield Guesthouse in Blackpool. Craig plans to reveal his cabaret-star alter-ego Sybil Du Vuax to his unsuspecting guests.

Day four of the competition is at The New Inn at Portland in Dorset, run by publicans and husband and wife team Stacey and Spencer Cullum. The hosts decide to show their guests a typical island activity - sandcastle building.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Cuando una mujer dice que el bebé que ella secuestró es suyo y de un respetado asesor jurídico, la investigación cambia las vidas de dos familias.

El padre del doctor Halstead es admitido en el hospital, pese a que él no quería. El doctor Charles toma medidas cuando su hija empieza a comportarse de manera todavía más extraña. La doctora Manning siente el agobio de trabajar y ser madre.

Una mujer desesperada por ayudar a su hija a combatir el cáncer. El Dr. Charles sugiere a Sarah conducir la evaluación psiquiátrica de su hija Robin. El Dr. Choi presiona a Noah cuando un puesto para residencia se libera.
Un niño baleado en su vecindario obliga a Cruz y su hermano a pensar en la pandilla. Isabella logra que Mills se vista para una fiesta de gala. Casey se siente triste porque verá menos a Dawson.

Boden intenta evitar que la estación de bomberos sea cerrada. Se produce un romance entre Dawson y Casey. Cruz se preocupa por la seguridad de su hermano. Severide y Katie recuperan el tiempo perdido.

Maverick, quien lleva 30 años de servicio, es ahora instructor de pilotos militares. Una última misión, un sacrificio final, obliga a este maestro de los cielos a enfrentar las heridas abiertas del pasado y sus temores más profundos.

El trampero Hugh Glass intenta vengarse de sus compañeros, quienes lo abandonaron herido en el bosque después de que lo atacó un oso, pensando que moriría, víctima de las lesiones y de la crudeza del entorno y del invierno. Sin embargo, el rencor que siente es más fuerte que cualquier adversidad, y Glass no permitirá que nada ni nadie le prive de saciar su odio.

Un hombre agradable e inseguro se ve obligado a competir por el cariño de los hijos de su esposa con el padre de los chicos cuando este regresa a la ciudad. Sus personalidades no podrían ser más diferentes: el padrastro es afable, el padre rebelde.

Dora se pone al frente de un equipo formado por su amigo peludo Botas; Diego, un misterioso habitante de la jungla; y un desorganizado grupo de adolescentes para salvar a los padres de Dora y resolver el misterio de una ciudad perdida de oro.

Roy McBride es un ingeniero que perdió a su padre en una misión sin retorno a Neptuno para encontrar signos de inteligencia extraterrestre. Veinte años después, emprende el mismo viaje a través del sistema solar para tratar de encontrarlo.

Un antiguo agente de las fuerzas especiales se encuentra al mando de un comando que debe cazar y matar al creador de una inteligencia artificial extraordinaria que tiene la capacidad de aniquilar a toda la humanidad.
El joven James T. Kirk, Spock y el resto de la tripulación del Enterprise se embarcan en un curso de colisión con un romulano vengativo.

La Flota Estelar ha sido destruida y la Tierra se encuentra en estado de crisis. El capitán Kirk encabeza una cacería humana en un mundo desgarrado con el objetivo de capturar al hombre que posee un arma de destrucción masiva.

Un estudiante de secundaria desaparece misteriosamente, y la policía debe analizar los chismes, las mentiras y los secretos profundamente personales de un grupo de adolescentes en un pequeño pueblo de Michigan para descubrir la verdad mortal.

Con solo 17 años, Catherine abandona su hogar en Ohio y viaja a Nueva York para cumplir el sueño de bailar en Broadway. Tres años después, la joven aparece asesinada a cuchilladas en su apartamento de Manhattan.

Cuando hallan a una destacada abogada apuñalada salvajemente en su oficina, los investigadores se encuentran con un sinnúmero de sospechosos, desde delincuentes violentos hasta triángulos amorosos lésbicos.
Lo que, en un principio, parecía una muerte producida por un ataque al corazón, tal vez fue un asesinato. Los investigadores descubren una espeluznante conspiración en el seno de una familia.

Asesinan a una mujer a tiros en el estacionamiento de su terapeuta. Las autoridades consideran en principio que fue un ataque aleatorio, pero la investigación demuestra que se trató de un crimen premeditado.
La policía detiene a un hombre ha estado asesinando a prostitutas durante dos años en el estado de Nueva York y vivienda con los cadáveres de sus víctimas almacenados en su casa.
Una pareja de adolescentes lleva sus obsesiones al extremo cuando su romance se ve amenazado por un compañero de clase.
Dos profesores de escuela planean conjuntamente un asesinato para cobrar del seguro.
Los bomberos van a un incendio y encuentran tres víctimas de disparo dentro de la casa; las autoridades persiguen al asesino armado en Navidad.
La vida de ensueño de dos adolescentes enamorados se torna una pesadilla cuando el secreto de uno de ellos conoce la luz.

Un traficante de documentación guarda un oscuro secreto sobre unos artefactos religiosos que ha descubierto. Por otro lado, comienzan a explotar bombas en la comunidad y los detectives trabajan a contrarreloj para encontrar al asesino y detener el baño de sangre.
En vísperas de Navidad en un pueblo silencioso, Bob e Idella Young son brutalmente asesinados en su casa; encuentran un guante ensangrentado en la escena del crimen que tiene el ADN del asesino.

Una aspirante a escritora y pintora en la vibrante escena artística del Soho de principios de los 80 es asesinada, solo dos días después de la publicación de su primer libro. Su esposo devastado por el crimen comparte una pista importantísima.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Dos empleados de una empresa familiar de casas móviles son asesinados a tiros. Los detectives se quedan sin pistas sobre el móvil. La búsqueda de un auto desaparecido revela a un asesino movido por las viejas intenciones.

El grupo de trabajo investiga el secuestro de un astronauta de alto perfil en relación con otras desapariciones en la zona, lo que los lleva al salvaje mundo de los creadores de contenido para adultos. Remy y Abby luchan por ponerse de acuerdo.
Durante años, el rey Dankrat de Borgoña ha traído orden, estabilidad, prosperidad y paz a su tierra y a su pueblo.
Un rostro de la infancia de Luke regresa, y el personal de Roman, Irlanda, investiga a un vaquero fantasmal.
El equipo de Roman, Irlanda, ayuda a un padre soltero con el trastorno del sueño paranormal de su hijo adolescente.
Luke conoce a la personificación de la Muerte, quien necesita un poco de ayuda con un antiguo cliente.

Maggie trabaja encubierta en un bar para investigar a un grupo antigubernamental que se reúne regularmente en el lugar. Un padre soltero comienza a temer que está en peligro de convertirse en una víctima colateral.

Cuando un estudiante universitario musulmán y su hermano menor son asesinados, el equipo conecta con el indignado imán de la antigua mezquita de OA, que insiste en que las víctimas fueron erróneamente señaladas como terroristas.
Durante años, el rey Dankrat de Borgoña ha traído orden, estabilidad, prosperidad y paz a su tierra y a su pueblo.

House y el equipo se encargan del caso de una mujer judía que colapsa el día de su boda. House sospecha que la reciente conversión religiosa de la paciente es evidencia de una enfermedad mental, lo que ocasiona un conflicto con su esposo.

Un paciente con una excelente disposición parece tener un problema mayor del que fue diagnosticado previamente. House sospecha que la buena actitud del sujeto es un síntoma, pero el equipo difiere e intenta llegar al fondo del asunto.

House está convencido de que uno de los actores de su telenovela favorita sufre una enfermedad grave y decide intervenir en el caso, pero el actor y su equipo médico rechazan su diagnóstico, así que House decide hacerse cargo por su cuenta.

House tiene un accidente en un autobús y pierde un par de horas de su memoria. De a poco, recuerda que un pasajero mostraba signos de una enfermedad mortal, pero los detalles de quién era la persona están atrapados en su cabeza.

Los sombríos recuerdos de House acerca del accidente de autobús son la clave para el diagnóstico de Amber, pero la situación pone a prueba su amistad con Wilson y amenaza con cambiar sus vidas para siempre.

Wilson aún está de luto por la muerte de su novia y renuncia al hospital Princeton Plainsboro. House busca determinar si es responsable de la muerte de la novia de su mejor amigo. Trece lucha para atender objetivamente a un paciente.

La historia de seis parejas que tienen dificultades en sus matrimonios y los problemas que tienen que enfrentar día a día; las esposas que luchan por sacar adelante el hogar tratando de equilibrar su vida hogareña con sus trabajos.

Paula Bernal y Rogelio Iturbide son dos personas con vidas muy distintas que, al conocerse, deciden casarse sin avisar a la familia de Rogelio, en especial a la matriarca de la familia, Martina Rangel.
A los 17 años, Rina queda viuda y millonaria. Su cuñada Rafaela trama un plan para casarla con su hijo Carlos Augusto para despojarla de su fortuna.

Lety es una chica muy inteligente pero poco agraciada, más bien fea, que se graduó con honores en economía, habla varios idiomas y es una genia en las finanzas, pero por su físico no encuentra trabajo. Desesperada por encontrar empleo, acepta que la contraten por debajo de su capacidad y se emplea como secretaria en una famosa productora de videos llamada Conceptos en donde la fealdad es un tabú.

Melchor le explica a Pablo que su madre lo odia porque abusó de ella hace muchos años. El jefe de Diana la descubre realizando una llamada personal con sus hermanas y corta la llamada. Diana sufre maltrato por parte de su jefe.

Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.
